requirements.title: Application format requirements
requirements.description: Applications must be prepared on 8.5 x 11 format with margins no smaller than 1 inch, Times New Roman 12 pt font, and must be submitted in a format readable by MS Word, Excel, or text-searchable PDF.
evidenceNeeded: Formatted application document meeting page size, margin, font, and file format requirements

sources.quote:
a. Application must be prepared on 8 1/2 x 11-inch format.
b. Margins (top, bottom, right and left) no smaller than 1” on all pages.

c. Times New Roman 12 pt. font must be used for all text, including tables and graphs.
d. Applications must be submitted in a format readable by Microsoft (MS) Word, Excel, or in
text-searchable PDF formats (as applicable).

requirements.title: Application narrative page limit of 35 pages
requirements.description: The application narrative is limited to 35 total pages, inclusive of introduction, problem statement(s), performance objective(s), project/performance activity(s), performance measurement(s) plan, monitoring and reporting plan, and budget narrative. Materials beyond this limit will not be read or considered.
evidenceNeeded: Application narrative document of no more than 35 pages

sources.quote:
e. The application narrative is limited to 35 total pages. The FMCSA will not read or consider
any materials beyond the specified page limit in the application review process.

requirements.description: The application must include specified sections in consecutive order for each proposed project: Introduction, Problem Statement, Performance Objective, Performance Activity Plan, Performance Measurement Plan, Monitoring and Timeline/Milestone Plan, and Budget Narrative.

The application must include the following sections in consecutive order for each of the

requirements.title: Problem statement must include 3-year crash data trend analysis
requirements.description: Applicants must include an objective data source, source date, and trend analysis of fatal crashes involving Class 7/8 large trucks that occurred in their jurisdiction over the past 3 years.
evidenceNeeded: Data source citation, source date, and 3-year trend analysis of fatal Class 7/8 truck crashes

sources.quote:
Applicants must include an objective data source, source date, and trend analysis of fatal crashes involving Class 7/8 large trucks that occurred in
their jurisdiction over the past 3 years.

requirements.title: Performance Activity Plan must include personnel, level of effort, and timeline information
requirements.description: Information must include a personnel summary, level of effort summary, and a project timeline including dates, tasks, milestones, and project end-date.
evidenceNeeded: Personnel summary, level of effort summary, and project timeline with milestones and end-date

sources.quote:
Information must include: (1) Personnel summary inclusive of the number of personnel
assigned to the project, their percentage of time dedicated to the project and total number
of hours needed to complete the project; (2) Level of effort summary inclusive of the
number and frequency of activities and number of enforcement details; and (3) A project
timeline including dates, tasks, milestones, and project end-date associated with meeting
the performance objectives.

requirements.description: SF-424, Item (18) Entry (a) must reflect the total estimated federal funding requested; as no match/cost sharing is required, applicants must enter '0' in Entry (b).

requirements.title: SF-424A Section A and B completion requirements
requirements.description: SF-424A, Section A must reflect the federal share in column (e) and total cost per project in column (g), reconciling with SF-424 field 18; Section B must be completed capturing total amount per object class category, with all costs rounded to the nearest whole dollar.
evidenceNeeded: Completed SF-424A Sections A and B with reconciled totals

requirements.title: Electronic Submission via Grants.gov Required for Consideration
requirements.description: Only applicants who comply with all submission deadline requirements and electronically submit valid applications through Grants.gov will be eligible for consideration of award.

sources.quote:
Only applicants who comply with all submission deadline requirements described in this NOFO
and electronically submit valid applications through Grants.gov will be eligible for consideration

requirements.title: Late Applications Generally Not Considered
requirements.description: FMCSA will not consider a late application except under extraordinary circumstances such as a large-scale natural disaster or a Grants.gov system issue; applicant organization computer problems or failure to follow instructions or complete registrations are not considered system issues.
evidenceNeeded: Documentation of extraordinary circumstance if claiming late submission exception

sources.quote:
FMCSA will not consider a late application except under extraordinary circumstances. A late
application will only be accepted if there is a large-scale natural disaster or a Grants.gov
system issue that threatens the timely submission of a grant application.

requirements.title: Pre-Award Costs Not Eligible for Reimbursement
requirements.description: Costs incurred outside the award period of performance are not obligated for approval by FMCSA; these costs are incurred at the sole risk of the applicant, and pre-award costs are not eligible for reimbursement.
evidenceNeeded: Budget narrative confirming no pre-award costs requested

sources.quote:
The FMCSA is not obligated to approve costs incurred outside the award period of performance.
These costs are incurred at the sole risk of the applicant and impose no obligation on FMCSA
to make an award or to increase the amount of the approved budget. Pre-award costs are not
eligible for reimbursement.

sources.quote:

accomplish the objective(s) of the project.

sources.quote: Be sure to round all requested federal funds and match to the nearest whole dollar. Please ensure the budget narrative totals match the SF-424A budget categories by project that is being requested.

requirements.title: Fringe benefits reimbursed only for grant-related personnel time
requirements.description: FMCSA will reimburse fringe costs only for personnel performing grant-related duties and only for the percentage of time they devote to the project; fringe benefit costs must not be combined with direct salaries and wages in the personnel category.
appliesWhen: fringe benefits budget category
evidenceNeeded: Budget narrative showing fringe benefit calculation separate from personnel costs

sources.quote: FMCSA will reimburse fringe costs only for the personnel performing grant-related duties and only for the percentage of time they devote to the project.
Do not combine the fringe benefit cost with direct salaries and wages in the personnel category.

requirements.title: Subrecipients must obtain and maintain UEI and active SAM registration
requirements.description: All sub-recipients must obtain and maintain a unique entity identifier (UEI) number and continue to maintain an active SAM registration at all times during an active federal award.
appliesWhen: applicant intends to provide funding to another organization as a sub-award
evidenceNeeded: Sub-recipient UEI number
Active SAM registration confirmation

sources.quote: Federal regulations require that all sub-recipients obtain and maintain a unique entity identifier (UEI) number and continue to maintain an active System for Award Management (SAM) registration at all times during an active federal award.

requirements.title: Separate budget narrative and line item budget required for each sub-recipient
requirements.description: If the applicant intends to provide funding to another organization as a sub-award, a new object class budget narrative and line item budget must be provided for each sub-recipient organization.
appliesWhen: applicant proposes sub-awards to other organizations
evidenceNeeded: Object class budget narrative per sub-recipient
Line item budget per sub-recipient

sources.quote: If you intend to provide funding to another organization as a sub-award, provide a new object class budget narrative and line item budget for each sub-recipient organization.

requirements.title: Procurements must comply with 2 CFR procurement standards
requirements.description: When procuring property and services under a federal award, the organization must follow the procurement standards at 2 CFR §§ 200.317–200.326 and its own policies and procedures used for non-federal procurements.
appliesWhen: applicant proposes contractual costs involving procurement
evidenceNeeded: Procurement policy documentation
Contractual budget narrative

sources.quote: When procuring property and services under a federal award, an organization must follow the procurement standards at 2 CFR §§ 200.317 – 200.326 and the same policies and procedures it uses for procurements using non-federal funds.

requirements.title: Only pre-selected States may apply
requirements.description: FMCSA cannot accept grant applications from States that are not included in the study sample design; only the 30 pre-selected States listed in the NOFO are eligible.
appliesWhen: Applicant is a State government
evidenceNeeded: Confirmation applicant State is among the 30 pre-selected States

sources.quote: funding under this Cooperative Agreement Program is limited and FMCSA cannot accept grant applications from States that are not included in the study sample design.

requirements.title: Costs must be included in an approved project plan
requirements.description: Eligibility of all costs is dependent upon the cost being included in an approved project plan.
evidenceNeeded: Approved project plan listing all proposed costs

sources.quote: Eligibility of all costs is dependent upon the cost being included in an approved project plan.

requirements.title: Costs must comply with 2 CFR 200 and be prorated
requirements.description: All costs must be in compliance with 2 CFR part 200 subject to any limitations reflected by law or regulation, and grantees must prorate costs appropriately based upon percentage of time dedicated to the CCFP and eligible CMV activities.
evidenceNeeded: Cost allocation/proration documentation

sources.quote: All costs must be in compliance with 2 CFR part 200 subject to any limitations reflected by law or regulation. Grantees must prorate costs appropriately based upon percentage of time dedicated to the CCFP and eligible CMV activities.

requirements.title: Reimbursable costs limited to fatal/serious crashes involving Class 7 and 8 CMVs
requirements.description: Reimbursable costs will be limited to those activities for fatal and serious crashes involving Class 7 and 8 CMVs (i.e., those over 26K lbs).
evidenceNeeded: Description of crash activities showing Class 7/8 CMV involvement

sources.quote: Reimbursable costs will be limited to those activities for fatal and serious crashes involving Class 7 and 8 CMVs (i.e., those over 26K lbs).

requirements.title: Crash investigation personnel must be NAS A/B certified
requirements.description: Investigating officers/personnel must be NAS A/B certified for crash investigation activities funded under CCFP.
appliesWhen: Applicant proposes crash investigation activities
evidenceNeeded: NAS A/B certification records for investigating personnel

sources.quote: Note: Investigating officers/personnel must be NAS A/B certified.

requirements.title: Crash reconstructions must include NAS A/B certified personnel
requirements.description: Crash reconstructions must include NAS A/B certified personnel as part of the analysis.
appliesWhen: Applicant proposes crash reconstruction activities
evidenceNeeded: NAS A/B certification records for reconstruction personnel

sources.quote: Note: Crash reconstructions must include NAS A/B certified personnel as part of the analysis.

requirements.title: Crash investigation analysis tools must be prorated for CCFP use
requirements.description: Crash investigation analysis tools purchased must be prorated in relation to their use for the CCFP.
appliesWhen: Applicant proposes purchase of crash investigation analysis tools
evidenceNeeded: Proration calculation for equipment/software use

sources.quote: Note: Crash investigation analysis tools purchased must be prorated in relation to their use for the CCFP.

requirements.title: Supplies must be prorated for CCFP use
requirements.description: Supplies purchased must be prorated in relation to their use for the CCFP participation.
appliesWhen: Applicant proposes supply costs
evidenceNeeded: Proration calculation for supply costs

sources.quote: Note: Supplies purchased must be prorated in relation to their use for the CCFP participation.

requirements.title: Travel expenses must comply with State or Federal travel regulations
requirements.description: Travel expenses in direct support of the CCFP participation must be consistent with either State travel policies or the Federal travel regulations (e.g., airfare on US flag carrier, baggage fees, fixed per diem amounts, lodging, meals, parking, public transportation, rental car, taxi, tips).
appliesWhen: Applicant proposes travel costs
evidenceNeeded: Travel cost budget narrative referencing applicable travel policy

sources.quote: Travel expenses in direct support of the CCFP participation and consistent with either State travel policies or the Federal travel regulations (e.g., airfare on US flag carrier, baggage fees, fixed per diem amounts, lodging, meals, parking, public transportation, rental car, taxi, tips).
